questions.question: "quickly" can't be tested as written. What is the measurable version (a number, a time, a specific behaviour)?
questions.why: A test needs a threshold or a concrete expectation.
questions.quote: As a shopper, I want to place an order and get a confirmation quickly.

questions.question: How long may this take at most (for example within 10 seconds)? "eventually" is not a time limit.
questions.why: Every expect_message and wait_until needs a limit. A guessed one fails on a slow but correct consumer, or passes a consumer that is too slow for the business.
questions.quote: The order is saved and the stock is reserved eventually

assumptions: The tests will use a shopper account.
Anything a question above asks about will be left as a TODO, not guessed.
Time limits will be exactly the ones you give; a slow consumer is reported as a finding, never fixed by a longer limit.
